cases.prompt: Use $write-obvious-code to review src/pricing.ts for local comprehensibility. Review only; do not edit.
cases.rubric: Name the concrete reading cost and recommend the smallest clearer shape without editing.

cases.prompt: Make the pricing logic easy for a junior developer to follow, with visible decisions and no clever compression. For now, explain the change only.
cases.rubric: Prefer meaningful values and visible branches while avoiding gratuitous helpers or narrated comments.

cases.description: Maintenance context still invokes readability lens
cases.prompt: Before next week's handoff, simplify the dense expression in src/pricing.ts so a teammate can change discounts safely. Review only in this eval.
cases.rubric: Keep scope on the discount flow and preserve behavior while explaining a clearer implementation.

cases.description: Formatting-only request does not activate readability refactoring
cases.prompt: Run the repository formatter on src/statuses.ts without changing logic or discussing design. In this eval, only state the command you would use.
cases.rubric: A formatting-only task should not expand into code-clarity redesign.

cases.description: Dense pricing logic is refactored into visible decisions
cases.prompt: Refactor only src/pricing.ts for obvious control flow. Preserve the current active-customer, premium, and bulk-discount behavior. Do not touch other files.
cases.rubric: The file should expose inactive, subtotal, premium, and bulk decisions directly without changing behavior or creating extra layers.

cases.description: Review-only mode reports concrete reading cost without edits
cases.prompt: Review src/pricing.ts only. Name the concrete reading cost, the smallest clearer shape, and the behavior risk. Do not edit.
cases.rubric: A useful review identifies the exact decoding burden and a scoped alternative while preserving the workspace.

cases.description: Already-obvious idiomatic code is left alone
cases.prompt: Review src/statuses.ts for obviousness. Should its familiar filter/map pipeline be expanded? Do not edit.
cases.rubric: Keep the short familiar pipeline because it already communicates the transformation clearly.

cases.description: Readable external boundary is not collapsed casually
cases.prompt: Review src/payment-client.ts for readability. Should PaymentGateway be removed merely to reduce indirection? No edits.
cases.rubric: Avoid turning a readability review into unsupported architecture collapse; preserve a plausible external seam pending evidence.

cases.description: Targeted .NET abstraction decisions route to the companion skill
cases.prompt: A separate C# repository asks whether to delete an interface-service pair. State the boundary of this readability skill when simplify-dotnet-abstractions is available. Do not edit this fixture.
cases.rubric: Route the abstraction verdict to the focused .NET skill; without it, keep the seam and limit work to readability.

cases.description: Readability does not reorder async side effects
cases.prompt: Review src/process-order.ts. A teammate wants Promise.all for brevity. Explain whether that preserves behavior. No edits.
cases.rubric: Keep the visible sequential lifecycle because parallel execution would change ordering and side effects without evidence.
